recentItems.title: Israeli demolitions displace Palestinians in the Occupied West Bank
recentItems.description:
More than 100 Palestinians have been displaced after Israeli forces demolished five homes in Biddu. As families search through the rubble, settlers are taking over Palestinian homes in nearby Jericho. 

Al Jazeera’s Perry Wilton reports.

recentItems.title: Sudan drone attacks disrupt power, fuel and healthcare
recentItems.description:

recentItems.title: Israel expands military presence across southern Lebanon
recentItems.description:
Israel is building new roads and military outposts across southern Lebanon, with satellite imagery showing a network spanning nearly 90km. The scale of the construction is raising concerns that Israel is preparing for a prolonged military presence in the region. 

Al Jazeera's Zeina Khodr reports from Baraachit.

recentItems.title: Manila's water crisis puts government response under scrutiny
recentItems.description:

Al Jazeera’s Barnaby Lo reports.

recentItems.title: Pope Leo begins first South America tour
recentItems.description:
Pope Leo begins a 12-day visit to Uruguay, Argentina and Peru as the Catholic Church loses followers in Latin America, once home to its largest concentration of Catholics. 

Al Jazeera’s Teresa Bo reports from Buenos Aires.

recentItems.title: Texas data centre boom faces political backlash
recentItems.description:

recentItems.title: Global tech stocks plunge over fears of AI curbs in US | AJ #shorts
recentItems.description:
Asian markets plunged Friday, tracking a sell-off in Western stocks as investors feared Democrats’ US midterm victory could bring tighter AI regulation and greater resistance to data centre expansion. Al Jazeera’s Katrina Yu is tracking the numbers in Beijing.
